text: Organic chemistry is one of the core branches in the field of chemistry, specializing in the study of the structure, properties, synthesis methods, reaction mechanisms, and applications of carbon-based compounds. Due to its ability to form stable covalent bonds (single bonds, double bonds, triple bonds) and its capacity to combine with elements such as hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and sulfur, carbon elements have given rise to a vast array of complex organic molecules - ranging from proteins, DNA, and natural products (such as alkaloids, essential oils) in nature to synthetic drugs, plastics, dyes, and fragrances, which almost cover the core material basis of life activities and modern industry. Therefore, organic chemistry is hailed as "the chemistry of life" and "the art of synthesis".
